name: Nexa Repository Hub — Serve Plugins & Themes
author: NexaCMS
description: Turns this NexaCMS site into a package repository: other NexaCMS sites can add this site as a Repository and browse/install the plugins and themes you choose to publish. Serves a repo index JSON, on-the-fly package zips and package thumbnails (screenshot/thumbnail/icon files) of your shared installed plugins/themes.
